profiles.title: Conventional commercial-bank deposit money
profiles.claim_ceiling: Exact mechanism representation under this profile; no macroeconomic superiority or normative conclusion.

credit_creation.definition: Bank lending can create deposit liabilities under the applicable constraints.

reserve_or_backing.definition: Liquid assets and central-bank reserves; deposits are not individually fully reserved.

redemption_convertibility.definition: Deposit claims transferable/redeemable at par subject to bank solvency and resolution.

transaction_finality.definition: Payment-system finality anchored by settlement rules.

default_loss_allocation.definition: Capital, creditors/depositors, insurance and resolution regime.

transplant_contract.comparison_rule: candidate may differ only in mutable_layer

profiles.title: Sovereign Money / 100%-Money
profiles.claim_ceiling: Exact mechanism representation under this profile; no macroeconomic superiority or normative conclusion.

store_of_value_claim.definition: Direct claim on public monetary issuer.

credit_creation.definition: Transaction-money issuance is separated from bank lending; lending does not implicitly mint transaction money.

reserve_or_backing.definition: Public-money/reserve structure is explicit but implementation details vary.

redemption_convertibility.definition: Direct transferability within the public-money system.

transaction_finality.definition: Finality under the public payment/legal rules.

clearing_topology.definition: Public settlement rail linking transaction accounts/intermediaries.

interoperability.definition: Defined by the public payment rail.

default_loss_allocation.definition: Credit losses remain in the lending/intermediation layer rather than transaction-money issuance.

governance_legal_finality.definition: Public monetary authority and legal framework.

transplant_contract.comparison_rule: candidate may differ only in mutable_layer

profiles.title: Bounded Mutual Credit / credit-clearing network
profiles.claim_ceiling: Exact mechanism representation under this profile; no macroeconomic superiority or normative conclusion.

issuer_liability.definition: No central issuer liability is assumed.

credit_creation.definition: Trade creates equal positive and negative member positions within credit limits.

reserve_or_backing.definition: No external reserve is required for internal credit creation.

settlement_asset.definition: External money appears only at an explicit boundary.

redemption_convertibility.definition: Positive claims may be settled externally only under an explicit rule.

liquidity_backstop.definition: Not assumed in the base profile.

clearing_topology.definition: Bounded member network; genuine multilateral clearing is a separate v1 mechanism.

interoperability.definition: Not assumed in the base profile.

default_loss_allocation.definition: Not specified in the base profile.

governance_legal_finality.definition: Network membership/limits/ledger rules; broader legal finality remains separate.

transplant_contract.comparison_rule: candidate may differ only in mutable_layer

profiles.title: Tokenized commercial-bank deposits
profiles.claim_ceiling: Exact mechanism representation under this profile; no macroeconomic superiority or normative conclusion.

medium_of_exchange.definition: Tokenized deposit claims on programmable rails.

payment_instrument.definition: Tokenized representation of bank deposit liability.

reserve_or_backing.definition: Follows bank balance sheet and prudential framework, not a separate bearer reserve pool.

settlement_asset.definition: Central-bank money can provide interbank settlement.

redemption_convertibility.definition: Underlying deposit account is redeemable/transferable under bank rules.

transaction_finality.definition: Ledger finality plus payment/legal settlement rules.

liquidity_backstop.definition: Important under continuous settlement; exact arrangement must be specified.

clearing_topology.definition: Permissioned/interoperable ledger topology with possible atomic settlement.

default_loss_allocation.definition: Underlying bank insolvency and protection regime.

governance_legal_finality.definition: Ledger governance, legal ownership and settlement finality must be explicit.

transplant_contract.comparison_rule: candidate may differ only in mutable_layer

profiles.title: Reserve-backed fiat stablecoin
profiles.claim_ceiling: Exact mechanism representation under this profile; no macroeconomic superiority or normative conclusion.

payment_instrument.definition: Issuer-created token governed by its terms.

store_of_value_claim.definition: Claim exposure follows issuer, reserves and redemption terms.

credit_creation.definition: Token issuance is distinct from bank credit creation.

reserve_or_backing.definition: Reserve assets support outstanding token liabilities under the declared policy.

settlement_asset.definition: Redemption/settlement asset defined by the issuer; central-bank money is not assumed.

redemption_convertibility.definition: Par redemption is a design objective whose reliability depends on reserves/liquidity/issuer resilience.

liquidity_backstop.definition: Public/private backstop is design-dependent and not inherited.

clearing_topology.definition: Issuer ledger/network plus external exchanges/bridges where needed.

interoperability.definition: Cross-network interoperability is explicit and may introduce fragmentation risk.

default_loss_allocation.definition: Reserve priority, issuer resolution, redemption and regulation determine losses.

governance_legal_finality.definition: Issuer governance, reserve governance, ledger rules and law.

transplant_contract.comparison_rule: candidate may differ only in mutable_layer
